speaker: Pep Guardiola

Afternoon, guys. Mics on the either side. We'll  take a show of hands, come to as many of you  
as we can. We'll set embargo towards the end for  10.30 on Sunday evening. Let's start with Simon.  
Congratulations. Given the way the game started,  what does it say about the character of your team  
that you came back and won as well as you did? And  can you just talk about the performance of Kevin  
De Bruyne? The performance of Kevin, so as we have  done for many, many years, for many, many games.  
Unfortunately, lately could not help the problem  that he has injured for one year, a long year,  
so surgery and so on. But he played fantastic.  He helped us to break this momentum that was not  
good. But the game was started really well. We  played really good. Except the 2-0 down was a  
moment that normally for the situation, but we're  playing, it creates a lot of chances. You cannot  
forget Crystal Palace, the momentum that is coming  here with the best team in the last six games and  
the second best one in the last 10-11, much, much  better than us, for example, in terms of points.  
So 2-0 down was not easy, but yeah. We stick with  the plan and the players play really, really good  
in all senses. And the situation that we have,  the seven games left, now six. We need points  
to qualify Champions League, so that has been  massively important. I know you're in the middle  
of trying to qualify for the Champions League, but  when you see De Bruyne coming off and getting the  
standing ovation and then going round and he's  saying, waving to his children. Do you think he  
will not really be appreciated as good as he is  until he's not there anymore? Always the impact  
for the exceptional and talented players, always  are me, so of course. So I don't have any doubt  
about this. I said a few press conferences before,  so the grateful, the gratitude we have, I have to  
him is it's huge. So I've done incredible and I  know that we can deliver, had deliver, can deliver  
and happy he was just helping us. So he played, he  fought a lot against United. He was brilliant with  
the ball, but today was fought and with the ball  was so, so clever and the goals and the asses and  
we had, yeah, he helped a lot to win that game.  How did you feel when your team went 2-0 down?  
Well, not happy, but tried to be calm in terms of  we were not playing bad after 2-0, yeah, we lost  
a little bit. We went attack so quick, and when  that's happened against that or all the players,  
it's so difficult, Muñoz. It's difficult to do  with that, but after we can the goal for Kevin, we  
in the momentum, we scored two in the second part  with just just one or two things. We were more in  
the position and the teams you have to move them  right, left, left, right, right, left, left,  
right. You want to attack a little bit quicker,  you are in trouble. And with that, look how many  
chances we create. So we scored five goals, but  I remember three of my team from the keeper,

so that is the way we have done in many years is  that we had to do run solidarity that again since

in the position today, we were in the position  that's how we can find the players that can  
make the difference. Gundogan was extraordinary  today, so all of them, so that's why it's, yeah,  
it's a good weekend for us. We want each guys  to get through the west in the middle here. Hi,  
Pep. We saw De Bruyne's brilliance today. Do you  think that James McAtee can step up next season  
to be the sort of creative force? No one can.  No one can do what Kevin has done. I don't want  
to put one second pressure with the players that  we have now. I don't want to put the pressure to  
Maka. Maka played not many minutes, but I know  the quality that he has in in the final third,  
the score one goal, he could score four, have this  sense, you want to play can score four is because

think you've needed these comebacks where you've  actually sort of. . . The 2-0 down to back? Yeah,  
today and the Bournemouth one as well seemed like  a big, big result. Yeah. But this season, maybe  
it's the season where we come back more results.  We were not a team when the previous season,  
when we considered the goal, we weren't able to  turn around. This season, they've been this season  
many times. But this season, I've done because  we had not played good. The level have been  
quite similar like today. We have been up there  fighting with the top teams, but the team. . . has  
not playing good and without this energy that  was a characteristic of that generation of  
players. But some seasons happen, learn and try  to do the damage. Don't be as much as possible,  
go into Europe next season and fighting for  the FA Cup and prepare World Cup next season.  
I just thought like the way, how strong you were  going forward in the sort of last hour of the game  
today is something that you can hold on to going  into the more swing games in the next few weeks?  
Now we have two days off. Players must be mentally  resting. We prepare four or five days at Goodison  
Park and after an important week, like we have  the Aston Villa FA Cup, and I think we'll be  
ready. The players are exceptional, so the way we  are not playing, not good. I'm not going to tell  
that the players are not good. It's completely  the opposite. We didn't click, we didn't find the  
spark or the what we needed. I was. I didn't find  it going that direction to lift the place, go in

so you cannot do it all the time and important as  you see it. So in the season we have done, now the

will be miles, miles away back. And the Premier  League will speak for itself about that. And  
instead of that, it's okay, it's not perfect,  but it's in our hands in the last six games  
to qualify for the Champions League next season.  Do you actually feel that things are much better  
now? Like you said, they're not perfect, but. .  . better, you said after the Bournemouth game,  
you're back in those terms in terms of running.  I think he said that the spirit was back. I think  
Gundo gave an interview yesterday. He said  something's back. Is it? Yeah, I’m agree. I  
think that Bournemouth game, we were able both  me and the team to put the mirror in front of  
us and said, this is what watching the game in  Bournemouth in the Premier League when we lost  
the first game in the Premier League this season,  choose to one. Reviewing the game, I said, wow,  
I saw the reason why we were in the season what we  had. And we talked about that, we saw about that,  
and after I said, because the problem is identify  the problem and realise that it's a problem,  
and after that, move forward, try to make  a solution. Maybe it took a lot of time  
to realise on that, and since then, ultra, ultra  was not good. The game was boring. But we found,  
you know, we at least, you know, the  defenders and, okay, this is a part,

we can create chances. We can create chances,  because the talent is there. Look at the bench,  
how good they are, the injured. The players  you have behind the bench, you have Rodri,  
you have Manu, Nathan, Erling, so they’re top  class players. In the bench, imagine, Bernardo,  
a player that cannot identify my seasons and my  period here without him. And Matheus has been  
outstanding these last games. Since Bournemouth,  Semenyo in the game in the Premier League, wow,  
was a headache and he controlled him perfectly.  So the players make a step up and of course they  
want play the Champions next season and knowing  that will be so difficult with this from Park and  
Aston Villa next two games, I cannot say it will  be easy. So yeah, there’s the point. Just on Kevin  
again, obviously he's very technically gifted,  but he’s one of his best attributes, the fact  
that he is a leader. He kind of takes control  of games like this when the team is flagging  
occasionally. Kevin is not a vocal leader.  The leader is every day, during nine years,  
ten years, I've been every three days, except the  last year and a half, being there, being there,  
helping the team. And I have something talent  unique. Everybody knows it. I have a vision in  
the pass and have, you know, when the players  up front, Kevin has the ball and when it's feel  
like this, they know they can run because the ball  can be delivered. The problem is when make a run,  
when the deliver player is not with this talent,  but that’s why Kevin is the player in this history  
of this club, all history with most titles. So  with that, define who has done Kevin with us. Take
